dedupe_keys.name: agencia portuguesa do ambiente drought and low flow datasets

description: Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente: drought and low-flow datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente. Coverage: Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drought and low-flow; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: RH3 - Mapa 024. Seca hidrológica na região hidrográfica (SPI 12); Plano da Bacia Hidrográfica das Ribeiras do Oeste - Anexo 11 – Situaçõ; RH1 - Mapa 24. Seca hidrológica na região hidrográfica (SP 12); RH2 - Mapa 024. Seca hidrológica na região hidrográfica (SPI 12). Formats seen: PDF, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
